scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w electron-shell
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:electron: node scripts/prepare-desktop-test.mjs && npx playwright test --config electron/playwright.config.ts
